description: Ask another player into the current user's trade circle by their handle ("@name"). Friends are matched against each other in one call (match_circle). A request reaches only a handle that has a wantlist or tradelist published; any other handle answers "Nothing is published under @name", the same as a lookup, so this never tells whether a player exists. The user needs a handle of their own (set_handle): it is the only thing the friend sees of them. status "pending" waits for the friend to accept; a request they already sent is accepted at once ("accepted"). What a friend can see: exactly what the handle publishes (wantlists and tradelists), never the collection, a deck share, a name or an email. The account's plan holds a number of friends, requests sent included: past it the answer is a plan limit naming the page that describes plans.

handle.description: The friend's handle, written with its @
